rows.abstract: "PAGASA Modernization Act". The modernization program under this Act shall principally be a re-tooling of the PAGASA with modern equipment and facilities, including but not limited to, advanced observational and surveillance system for meteorological and hydrological elements, satellite based communication network, supercomputers for data processing analyses and forecasting, and computer based workstations for generating increased volume for detailed information. rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING AND PENALIZING THE BURNING AND DESECRATION OF FOREIGN NATIONAL FLAGS WITHIN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: "Protection of Foreign National Flags Act of 2000". It shall be unlawful for any person, whether a citizen of the Philippines or a foreigner, to knowingly mutilate, deface, defile, burn or cast contempt or commit any act or omission casting dishonoror ridicule upon the national flag of any foreign government with which the Philippines is in good international relations.  No diplomatic protest or any other act on the part of the offended nation or foreign government shall be necessary.  No acton the part of our Department of Foreign Affairs shall be necessary to institute a complaint.

rows.abstract: IN NO CASE SHALL ANY PERSON RESIDING IN A PROPERTY BELONGING TO ANOTHER, BE ALLOWED TO REGISTER WITHOUT PRESENTING ANY PROOF OF LEGAL RESIDENCE ATTESTED BY THE PUNONG BARANGAY OF THE PLACE WHEREIN HE PROPOSES TO VOTE. PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE PUNONG BARANGAY SHALL VERIFY AND KEEP THE RECORD OF THE ACTUAL NUMBER OF RESIDENTS IN A PARTICULAR PROPERTY OR DWELLING UNIT.
